examples.name: nasa-interview-cut
examples.title: A raw NASA interview, cut
examples.what: An unedited 8 min 38 s interview answering eight questions about Artemis II. KiroCut removed the false starts, stammers and fillers and tightened the pauses: 6 min 57 s, 98.7% of the kept words checked in the render.

examples.name: chat-smoke-test
examples.title: Edited from the chat, start to finish
examples.what: A 24 s synthetic spoken take (a computer voice over a test pattern) with a retake, a filler and a long pause, driven through the kirocut tools as the Kiro chat calls them: cut to 9 s, reviewed with a note, approved, captioned and zoomed in the default style, a line added at the end, then rendered. The replay shows each step.
